name: kolen-sdd-progress
description: Pane with the task progress of each open OpenSpec change, read locally from tasks.md

operatorPattern.title: Operator phase pattern
operatorPattern.description: Case-insensitive regular expression; a tasks.md phase heading that matches it counts as operator work. Empty uses the default.

gatePattern.title: Gate phase pattern
gatePattern.description: Case-insensitive regular expression; a matching phase with pending tasks that names another open change marks this change as blocked. Empty uses the default.

unverifiedMarker.title: Unverified marker
unverifiedMarker.description: Literal text counted in the design artifact. Empty disables the count.

progressFile.title: Progress file
progressFile.description: File in each change folder whose last '## ' heading is shown as the last activity. Empty disables it.
